mechanism: Coenzyme Q10 may reduce chloroquine efficacy by competing for mitochondrial uptake and altering intracellular pH-dependent drug distribution, while chloroquine can deplete cellular CoQ10 levels through oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction.
action: Monitor clinical response to chloroquine therapy; consider spacing administration times and maintaining consistent CoQ10 dosing if concurrent use is necessary; counsel patients on the importance of adherence to antimalarial therapy.
